text:
anya: urgent: routing misconfig caused intermittent 503s for EU customers. cutting emergency patch v2.4.1 to fix retry header behavior. planning a focused EU rollout in the 00:30-01:30 UTC change window. requesting expedited approvals to skip canary — customer-impacting errors ongoing. details: https://confluence/release/v2.4.1 (root)
deploybot: Deploybot: preflight checks passed. unit and smoke tests green. Canary-skip requires 2 approvers with release:approve.
chris: +1 from me if ops confirms spare capacity and oncall can monitor.
ops-oncall: confirmed eu-west1 has spare capacity. i'll stay oncall for the rollout. +1.
anya: rollback plan: immediate image pin to last-good sha ghi789, traffic roll back to 0% for new image, no DB changes. auto-rollback trigger: sustained 4m error rate > 2.5%. commands:```sh
# rollback
kubectl set image deploy/llm-router router=image:ghi789 -n prod-eu
deploybot rollback --thread 7065432100 --reason "auto-rollback"
```
megan: please add a one-line release note for CS. also ensure runbook mention of monitoring dashboards.
anya: release note appended: "v2.4.1 — emergency routing header fix to stop 503s in EU. rolling 00:30-01:30 UTC; no schema changes." link: https://docs/releases/v2.4.1-notes
deploybot: Approval count: 3 (anya, chris, ops-oncall). Initiating rollout in 3m. logs: https://deploylogs/7065432100
deploybot: Phase 1 (15%) -> OK (error-rate unchanged). Phase 2 (50%) -> OK (latency nominal). Phase 3 (100%) -> Completed. No elevated errors.
chris: running sanity probe: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X GET https://api.eu1.redwood/health` -> 200
ops-oncall: monitoring kv/routing metrics and 5xx stream. looks stable.
megan: thanks team — closing rollout and pinging product + support to publish notes. :tada:
